_doc: Voice casting for the TTS pipeline (tools/audio/voices.py, Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0). blend: Kokoro voice styles mixed by weight; speed: delivery tempo (drawl < 1); pitch: resampling factor applied after synthesis (also darkens formants, < 1 = lower/bigger); eq: post filters. Every speaker in the dialogue tables must be listed here.

ruth.desc: Ruth Caddell, 34. Low, dry, unhurried; a drawl that clips the ends of sentences.

man_rough.desc: Saloon tough, drover, outlaw: deep and gravelly.

man_town.desc: Townsman, clerk, farmer: plain middle voice.

man_old.desc: Old-timer, preacher, prospector: slower, lower, worn.

man_young.desc: Kid, ranch hand: quick and light.

woman_town.desc: Townswoman, hotel keeper: clear middle voice.
